en-us.Kanon_Dialogue_inoffice:
$kanon.name$ leans back behind her desk and looks up at the sound of someone entering.
"You're here. Sit."
en-us.Kanon_Dialogue_inoffice_End: "If there's nothing else, the door's over there. I have work to do."
en-us.Kanon_Dialogue_inoffice_Explain01:
$kanon.name$ rises, walks to the cabinet against the wall, and pulls open a drawer.
"Let me be clear. The Kiryu-gumi's business here is adult video: we shoot it, and we sell it. You'll be the director, in charge of filming, and you hand the finished product to me for distribution. Money comes in fast in this line of work, enough to clear that debt of yours."
en-us.Kanon_Dialogue_inoffice_Explain01b:
"Start small. Your home is your studio for now — show me something decent first."
"If you can keep this up, we could make this deal bigger down the line. The group owns a vacant studio — Miyama Pictures. When the time comes, it can be rented to you: rent plus maintenance, 460,000 a month, first month paid on the spot, billed monthly after that, and nobody's going to pay it for you."
en-us.Kanon_Dialogue_inoffice_Explain02:
She takes a camera and a few blank tapes out of the drawer and sets them on the desk.
"Use these to start. Consider them on loan from the Kiryu-gumi. What you shoot and how you shoot it is your call."
en-us.Kanon_Dialogue_inoffice_Explain03:
"Sales go through the office. Hand the films to me and they sell through the Kiryu-gumi's channel under an anonymous name — no commission taken, settled on the spot. All you need to do is clear the debt before graduation; paying it off early is fine too."
"As long as you put your heart into it, the Kiryu-gumi will keep you and your sister safe. Do well, and I might even spare you some free time."
"I'll be arranging the office staff, and they'll also be keeping an eye on you for me. You understand what that means."
en-us.Kanon_Dialogue_inoffice_Explain04:
"You shoot the AVs, we sell them, and you earn enough to pay off your debt."
"As for actresses, I have a list of candidates, all vetted in advance. Once you have a studio of your own, come to me for that list."
en-us.Kanon_Dialogue_inoffice_firstMeeting_del: "You took several days to show up. For someone who made a promise, you hardly seem to care. ...Never mind. You're here now, so sit down and let's talk."
en-us.Kanon_Dialogue_inoffice_firstMeeting_pun: "Right on time. Seems you took what I said to heart."
en-us.Kanon_Dialogue_NotInOffice: "This isn't the place to talk business. Didn't I tell you to come find me at the office later? The address is on the card."
en-us.Kanon_Dialogue_inoffice_Kanade:
$kanon.name$'s gaze passes over $self.name$ and settles on $kanade.name$ standing behind for a moment.
"This kid's got a fine face. She might be of use for the business at home."
"But that kind of thing needs her own consent. Talk it over with her properly once you're back — if she agrees, there'll be a place for her in this."

[You can now talk to $kanade.name$ about helping with the AV work]
en-us.kd_AC_end:
"If there's anything else you don't understand, come ask anytime. The door's over there."

[The Miyama household received %%item_recording_camera%% ×1 and %%item_recording_camera_Tape%% ×3]
[The Miyama household can now sell AVs anonymously through the Kiryu-gumi's channel]
